reason: I'll let my son do it while the school pilot is free, but I already pay his tuition sir every month and I trust him sitting with my child more than an app. Paying ₹299 extra on top of tuition for something on my phone in the evening is not going to happen.
objection: I still don't fully trust where my child's data goes. A 'promise' on paper from an AI company is easy to sign, and my phone is shared, so who else sees what is on it.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test clearly shows his weak chapters improved and the tuition sir himself says it helps, I might pay so I can cut down tuition hours.
